They are on a snowy candy-cane street at night inside a toy town: toy-shop windows glowing warm, candy-cane lamp posts, strings of colored lights, piles of wrapped presents, a big lit Christmas tree, gently falling snow. Bright, colorful, full of energy, every face clear and big enough to read on a small phone screen.

Reference roles, in attachment order: Image 1 is Crumbles' character identity. Image 2 is Nutmeg's character identity. Image 3 is Holly's character identity. Image 4 (LAST) supplies rendering style only. Use only the three requested characters. Do not copy characters or Halloween imagery from Image 4, or portrait rings/badges from Images 2 and 3. Preserve Crumbles' shoulder bite and icing details. Render at exactly 1920 x 1080.
